posts.author: Supibara_exe
posts.body:
I'd like to take a moment to introduce myself as a newcomer here.
My name is Marco, I'm from the beautiful city of Salzburg in Austria and a youthful 37 years old.
I've been a gamer since the very beginning – started back in the days of the NES with Super Mario and Zelda, then moved through the PS1 and PS2 era and have played pretty much every notable title up to today.
The reason I joined is that I recently discovered RPG Maker MZ and have already been experimenting with it quite a bit, getting familiar with the UI. I was honestly surprised by how accessible it is – it even allowed me to put together some short test games fairly quickly. I was mainly introduced to the engine through Omori, Undertale and Deltarune, which I've been a huge fan of for a long time.
I've now set myself the goal of realizing a bigger project, and I joined here to exchange ideas with others and hopefully find one or two collaborators for it. The project I'm working on (working title "Twins") is a game that I feel heads in a similar direction story-wise to Omori.
I started about a week ago and already have most of the main story worked out in my head – a rough design concept, the story plot, some initial smaller concepts, and a basic map structure I have visualized.
At the moment I'm looking for an illustrator who can bring my sketches to life – I'm thinking of a style similar to Omori but even a little warmer and more watercolor-like. I'm also looking for a pianist to help realize the game's sound design, though that's not the highest priority right now – if needed I'd also look for a freelancer on Fiverr.
I'm looking forward to a lively exchange with all of you – feel free to send me a DM anytime!
Best regards,
Marco
